member.name: T:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian
member.summary: Running median smoothing utilities for numerical sequences. Provides running median computation.
member.remarks: ComputeMedians performs a sliding-window median over the input with either MiddleMedian behavior (preserving borders) or AllMedian (applies to the entire sequence). The parameter named 'kernelWidth' in ComputeMedians represents the window size W (≥ 1; odd recommended). A convenience overload ComputeMediansByRadius accepts a true radius R and converts it to W = (2 × R) + 1 before delegating. When useMiddle = false (AllMedian), boundary handling can be customized via SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode (Symmetric, Replicate, ZeroPad, Adaptive).

member.name: T:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.CsvBrewService
member.summary: CSV export service. Produces one or more CSV files containing Initial, MiddleMedian, and AllMedian values.
member.remarks: The service splits outputs to multiple files if the row count would exceed Excel's row limit. Progress is reported both from median computation and from file writing. CSV headers include a "Boundary Mode" line describing the AllMedian boundary handling.

member.summary: Excel export service. Builds a workbook with Initial, MiddleMedian, and AllMedian columns and a line chart.

member.name: M:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.ComputeMedians(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double}, System.Boolean, System.Int32, System.Int32, System.IProgress{System.Int32}, AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode)
member.summary: Computes running medians (MiddleMedian if useMiddle = true; AllMedian if useMiddle = false) over the input.
member.param: Input data (List<Double>). Must not be null.
True for MiddleMedian (preserves borderCount elements on both ends); False for AllMedian.
Median window size W (≥ 1). Odd recommended; even widths are accepted (median = average of two middle values).
Number of border elements to keep unchanged when useMiddle = true. Ignored when useMiddle = false.
Optional progress reporter receiving the count of processed elements (0 … N).
Boundary handling used when useMiddle = false: Symmetric (default), Replicate, ZeroPad, or Adaptive. Ignored when useMiddle = true.
member.returns: List<Double> containing the smoothed values for each input element.
member.remarks: - For MiddleMedian, the first and last 'borderCount' values are copied from input; a clamped, variable-length window is used near edges. - For AllMedian, a fixed-length window uses the specified boundary mode to synthesize out-of-range samples; Adaptive slides the window fully inside the range. - Uses Parallel.For internally; progress reports are based on processed element counts (not percentages).
member.exception: Thrown if input is null.
Thrown if kernelWidth <= 0.

member.name: T:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode
member.summary: Boundary handling strategies for AllMedian smoothing near the sequence edges.
member.remarks: Applied only when useMiddle = false (AllMedian). MiddleMedian ignores BoundaryMode and uses a clamped, variable-length window.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Symmetric
member.summary: Periodic reflection at the edges (smoothest default).

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Replicate
member.summary: Clamp to the nearest edge value.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.ZeroPad
member.summary: Use zeros for out-of-range samples.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Adaptive
member.summary: Slide a full window inside the valid range; no synthetic samples.
